description: Pick cards from a 3-layer pile into your 7-slot bar. Three matching cards auto-eliminate. Clear the board before the deadline to win GAS! Tools: Undo (3 max, -30% each), Shuffle (1/game), Remove 3 (1/game). Every card layout is sealed inside a Morpheus TEE — only its hash commitment goes on-chain, so the full layout cannot be searched or scripted.
description_zh: 从三层牌堆中选取卡片放入 7 格卡槽。三张相同卡片自动消除。在截止时间前清空所有卡片即可赢得 GAS！工具：撤回（最多 3 次，每次 -30%）、洗牌（每局 1 次）、移出三张（每局 1 次）。每局牌面都在 Morpheus TEE 内密封——链上仅记录哈希承诺，完整牌面无法被搜索或脚本化。
name: Sheep Solitaire

operations.description: Pay the entry fee and start a beacon-seeded game. Easy: 0.02 GAS entry wins 0.1; Medium: 0.10 wins 0.5; Hard: 0.20 wins 1.
operations.name: Start Game

operations.description: Pull your accumulated GAS winnings and any unused entry credit back to your wallet.
operations.name: Withdraw Winnings

operation_panel.subtitle: Deposit the entry, clear the 3-layer card pile before the deadline, and win GAS.
operation_panel.title: Sheep Solitaire

aa.description: Direct OneGate and NeoLine signing flow is used for the initial release.

oracle.description: The game opens a Morpheus runtime session to seal the hidden card layout and verify the recorded picks before settlement. No callback is required; the contract verifies the TEE signer directly on-chain.

tee.description: Morpheus TEE signs the hidden puzzle commitment and final settlement digest; the contract verifies the enclave signer directly without a Morpheus oracle callback.
